# Matteflux

> Ambient motion for heroes & footers.

Matteflux provides free, production-ready video background components for websites. Each set is a matching hero and footer pair from the same visual family, with desktop and mobile compositions, poster images, and ready-made code for HTML/CSS, Framer, and Webflow.

All sets are free for personal and commercial use (CC0 1.0).

Website: https://matteflux.com
GitHub: https://github.com/mertJF/matteflux
Docs: https://matteflux.com/docs/

## Available sets

Dark Ambient collection:
- Ember Aurora — amber light drifting over a teal dusk
- Night Fog — slow, low-contrast haze rolling past
- Deep Water — caustic light on a dark water surface
- Silk — flowing fabric waves in warm bronze
- Violet Tide — fluid violet folding into midnight navy
- Nebula — warm and cool gas clouds drifting through deep space

Earthen collection:
- Mist — warm copper haze on a bright clay ground
- Linen — bright golden fabric with amber warmth
- Ripple — bright emerald refractions on a jade ground

## What each set includes

- Hero video: 2560x1440 (desktop, 16:9) + 1080x1920 (mobile, 9:16)
- Footer video: 2560x854 (desktop, 3:1) + 1080x1350 (mobile, 4:5)
- Formats: MP4 + WebM, 8-10 seconds, seamless loop, silent
- Poster images: JPG + WebP for each video (instant LCP)
- Code: HTML/CSS, Framer, Webflow integration files

## Download

All sets are available as ZIP files from GitHub Releases:
https://github.com/mertJF/matteflux/releases/tag/v1.0

ZIP filename pattern: matteflux-{num}-{slug}.zip
Example: matteflux-01-ember-aurora.zip

## Integration (HTML/CSS)

Three files are needed: matteflux.css, matteflux.js, and the video/poster assets.

### 1. Add the stylesheet and preload the hero poster:

```html
<link rel="preload" as="image" href="/posters/{slug}-hero-desktop.webp"
      media="(min-width: 768px)" fetchpriority="high">
<link rel="preload" as="image" href="/posters/{slug}-hero-mobile.webp"
      media="(max-width: 767px)" fetchpriority="high">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/matteflux.css">
```

### 2. Hero section markup:

```html
<section class="mf-section mf-section--hero">
  <div class="mf-bg" style="--mf-overlay: 0.2">
    <picture class="mf-bg__poster">
      <source media="(max-width: 767px)" srcset="/posters/{slug}-hero-mobile.webp" type="image/webp">
      <source media="(max-width: 767px)" srcset="/posters/{slug}-hero-mobile.jpg">
      <source srcset="/posters/{slug}-hero-desktop.webp" type="image/webp">
      <img src="/posters/{slug}-hero-desktop.jpg" alt="" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async">
    </picture>
    <video class="mf-bg__video" muted loop playsinline preload="none" aria-hidden="true"
           data-mf-load="eager"
           data-mf-desktop="/hero/{slug}-hero-desktop"
           data-mf-mobile="/hero/{slug}-hero-mobile"></video>
    <div class="mf-bg__overlay"></div>
  </div>
  <!-- Your hero content goes here -->
</section>
```

### 3. Footer section markup:

```html
<footer class="mf-section mf-section--footer">
  <div class="mf-bg" style="--mf-overlay: 0.35">
    <picture class="mf-bg__poster">
      <source media="(max-width: 767px)" srcset="/posters/{slug}-footer-mobile.webp" type="image/webp">
      <source media="(max-width: 767px)" srcset="/posters/{slug}-footer-mobile.jpg">
      <source srcset="/posters/{slug}-footer-desktop.webp" type="image/webp">
      <img src="/posters/{slug}-footer-desktop.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
    </picture>
    <video class="mf-bg__video" muted loop playsinline preload="none" aria-hidden="true"
           data-mf-load="lazy"
           data-mf-desktop="/footer/{slug}-footer-desktop"
           data-mf-mobile="/footer/{slug}-footer-mobile"></video>
    <div class="mf-bg__overlay"></div>
  </div>
  <!-- Your footer content goes here -->
</footer>
```

### 4. Add the script before </body>:

```html
<script src="/matteflux.js" defer></script>
```

## Key CSS classes and variables

- .mf-section — container with position: relative, overflow: hidden
- .mf-section--hero — full viewport height (100svh)
- .mf-section--footer — responsive height (clamp 360-720px desktop, 4:5 mobile)
- .mf-bg — absolute positioned background layer (poster + video + overlay)
- --mf-overlay — overlay darkness (0 = none, 1 = black). Typical: hero 0.2, footer 0.35
- --mf-position — object-position for video/poster (default: 50% 50%)

## JavaScript data attributes

- data-mf-desktop — video path without extension (e.g. "/hero/ember-aurora-hero-desktop")
- data-mf-mobile — mobile video path without extension
- data-mf-load — "eager" for hero (loads immediately), "lazy" for footer (IntersectionObserver)
- data-mf-breakpoint — mobile breakpoint in px (default: 767), set on any ancestor

## Behavior

- Automatically picks WebM or MP4 based on browser support
- Switches between desktop and mobile compositions at the breakpoint
- Lazy videos load when near viewport (300px margin)
- Videos pause when off-screen
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (shows poster only)
- Respects Save-Data header (shows poster only)
- Call window.Matteflux.refresh() after dynamically adding new sections

## Performance tips

- Always preload the hero poster image
- Use data-mf-load="eager" only for the hero, "lazy" for everything else
- Host videos on a CDN for best loading speed
- The poster image is the LCP element — make sure it is optimized
- Videos are silent and small (typically under 2 MB each)

## Overlay values

Each set has tested overlay recommendations in its README. General guidelines:
- Hero: 0.15-0.30 (lighter, the video is the star)
- Footer: 0.25-0.45 (darker, text legibility matters more)
- Increase overlay if placing light text over bright video areas
